instructions: See docs/positions-lookup.md. Fill in "positions" for each player, most natural first, using only values from "allowed". The first must come from "primaryMustBeOneOf". Set confidence to high, medium or low.

players.name: Sol Campbell
players.note: Centre-back at Spurs throughout the nineties; used at right-back in his early seasons. FBref's FW tail reflects occasional emergency forward duty, not a regular role.

players.name: Frank Lampard
players.note: Goalscoring central midfielder at West Ham.

players.name: Jamie Carragher
players.note: Utility defender in these seasons: right-back and left-back as often as centre-back, plus some central midfield.

players.name: Gareth Southgate
players.note: FBref's DF label is his later career, not 1992/93: Southgate played central midfield for Crystal Palace that season, scoring 3 and setting up 4. He only converted to centre-back at Palace a couple of years afterwards.

players.name: Phil Neville
players.note: Primarily left-back in this period, also right-back and central midfield.

players.name: Gareth Barry
players.note: Broke through partly as the left-sided player in Villa’s back three, but central midfield is where he settled and the MF label points the same way.

players.name: Emile Heskey
players.note: Centre-forward at Leicester; also used wide left.

players.name: Paul Scholes
players.note: Played off the striker as an attacking midfielder in these seasons, before dropping deeper in the 2000s.

players.name: Aaron Hughes
players.note: Versatile young Newcastle defender, used at centre-back and across both full-back slots.

players.name: George Boateng
players.note: Box-to-box at Coventry, deeper and more destructive later at Villa.
